The '''Primtara system''' was located in the [[Primtara sector/Legends|Primtara sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Primtara Offensive]], a campaign in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="RoE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Primtara [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-15.<ref name="TEA" />
